subject: FIND-STRING function
notes: r1's whole admitted set in one program - three classes x the data-item and literal species: PIC A(9); PIC X(9), an alphanumeric GROUP searched across the child boundary, PIC XXBXX alphanumeric-edited, Table 2's numeric-edited-with-usage-display species, and an alphanumeric literal; PIC N(9) (first and LAST) and a national literal; plus a reference-modified view (§8.4.3.3.4 r6). Nine of the ten values were unreachable by any prior case, which used a single PIC X item. The defect the numeric-edited species exposes is §15.37.3 r2's CROSS screen and is charged to AR-15.37.3-2, not here: r1's own screen admits the item (IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs:959 lists NumericEditedDeEditing in the 's' set).
